QUOTE: The section is rejected, and the build falls back to the whole repo with a WARNING, if it is not a mapping, has an unknown key (so `exclude:` for `excludes:` fails), or has no usable `roots:`. ... A WARNING says so, so the boundary is logged rather than silent.

WHY: The answer mentions a WARNING on fallback but never says the fallback carries a reason field explaining which scope was used and why.
